text: `intent todo --json` emits valid JSON: an object keyed by bucket (doing/todo/done), each a list of threads carrying `id` / `title` / `status`, each thread carrying its work packages (`id` / `title` / `status`). The JSON and markdown emitters share one enumeration of `intent/st/**` (Highlander -- no second traversal).
